options.content: The table below lists traces for the selected KIO's recent requests (Trace ID, duration, root span). Copy a row's **Trace ID** value and paste it into the **Trace ID** box above — the panel below then shows that request's step-by-step sequence (repo_scan → prepare_prompt → llm_call → postprocess) as a waterfall view. If the panel stays empty, the same Trace ID can also be opened via Explore → Tempo.

panels.title: Son trace'ler ($kio_id)
panels.description: Session ID regex filter added (v2 guideline); uses the TraceQL =~ regex operator.

panels.title: Waterfall view of the selected trace ($trace_id)
D1.1 Real Project KPIs — kio2-sim (bugfix role, all SIMULATED)
Bug-fix time (KPI 6.1, simulated)
panels.description: Always source=simulated: this D1.1 project-management KPI has no real measurement path yet — it will become real once FocusTracer is connected (Section 9.8). Produced via KIO_REAL_KPI_ROLE=bugfix (kio2-sim only).

panels.title: Issue resolution time (KPI 1.2, simulated)
panels.description: Always source=simulated: this D1.1 project-management KPI has no real measurement path yet — it will become real once FocusTracer is connected (Section 9.8). Produced via KIO_REAL_KPI_ROLE=bugfix (kio2-sim only).

panels.title: Dynamic slicing success rate (WP3, target ≥85%, simulated)
panels.description: Always source=simulated: this D1.1 project-management KPI has no real measurement path yet — it will become real once FocusTracer is connected (Section 9.8). Produced via KIO_REAL_KPI_ROLE=bugfix (kio2-sim only).

panels.title: Customer-reported issues (KPI 6.2, simulated)
panels.description: Always source=simulated: this D1.1 project-management KPI has no real measurement path yet — it will become real once FocusTracer is connected (Section 9.8). Produced via KIO_REAL_KPI_ROLE=bugfix (kio2-sim only).

panels.title: Bug-fix / Issue resolution time trend (hours, simulated)
Model Comparison & Data Source (adapted from the idt4gdc-grafana-demo style)
Data source (tok/s) — REAL vs SIMULATED
panels.description: Counted as 'real' when KIO2_REAL_LLM_ENABLED is on and the real Ollama call succeeds; counted as 'simulated' when Ollama is unreachable and it falls back to simulation. Shows how many requests came from each source in the last 30 minutes.

panels.title: Energy Consumption by Model
panels.description: Inspired by the same-named panel in idt4gdc-grafana-demo. Uses our PromQL/VictoriaMetrics data instead of Postgres+rawSql: compares energy consumption rate across all KIOs (grouped by the llm label) ($kio_id filter intentionally omitted — this is a model-based comparison).

panels.title: Accuracy (fix@1) vs Energy Trade-off — by model
panels.description: Adapted from the 'Accuracy vs Energy Trade-off' panel in idt4gdc-grafana-demo. Shows the fix@1 success rate for KIO2 (bugfix role) side by side with its energy consumption rate. fix@1 is not yet connected to FocusTracer and is a placeholder value — see docs/AI4SWENG_KPI_Metrik_Referansi. Only KIOs in the bugfix role (currently KIO2) have data.

panels.title: Avg accuracy (gauge)
panels.description: fix@1 (kio.request.accuracy) is still a simulated value — see Section 9.4/9.7 (KIO7 scope).

panels.title: Instantaneous Power (W)
panels.description: The rate of kio.llm.energy_joules is already J/s = Watt; real GPU power in real mode, a fixed per-model coefficient in simulated mode.

panels.title: Verimlilik (tok/W)
panels.description: Average tok/s ÷ Watt — our data's equivalent of the 'performance per watt' concept. No new measurement needed, a pure PromQL derivation.

panels.title: Cumulative Carbon (kg CO2e, estimated)
panels.description: An ESTIMATED value derived from energy using a fixed grid-average assumption of 0.4 kg CO2e/kWh — not a real carbon measurement. No health threshold since it is cumulative (since process start), hence the neutral color.

panels.title: GPU Temperature (real — kio2-sim in real mode only)
GPU Temperature (°C)
panels.description: Only produces data when KIO2_REAL_LLM_ENABLED=true AND power-exporter/NVML is actually reachable (kio.llm.gpu_temperature_celsius, source=real). Seeing 'No data' on this panel when disabled or unavailable is expected behavior — it is never faked.

panels.title: Energy rate: Simulated vs Real (W)
panels.description: Average power broken down by the source=real|simulated label — even with kio2-sim's real mode on, both bars can appear if simulated-mode data was collected previously.

panels.title: D1.1 Real Project KPIs — kio3/kio4 (nlp-requirements / architecture-to-code, all SIMULATED)
Code generation speed (KPI 1.1, simulated)
panels.description: Produced in the kio3 (nlp-requirements) and kio4 (architecture-to-code) roles; N/A is expected on kio2-sim since its role differs.

panels.title: Code quality improvement (KPI 3.1, simulated)
panels.description: Produced in the kio3 (nlp-requirements) and kio4 (architecture-to-code) roles; a lower percentage means fewer quality issues relative to baseline (per the D1.1 definition).

panels.title: Review score (KPI 3.2, simulated, KIO4 only)
panels.description: Only produced in the architecture-to-code role (kio4); N/A is expected behavior on kio2-sim and kio3.

panels.title: D1.1 Real Project KPIs — kio7 (ai-sysdev, all SIMULATED)
Developer productivity (KPI 4.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the ai-sysdev role (kio7); N/A is expected behavior on other KIOs.

panels.title: Time-to-market (KPI 5.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the ai-sysdev role (kio7); baseline ~30-45 days, lower is better.

panels.title: Annual cost saving (KPI 7.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the ai-sysdev role (kio7).

panels.title: Refactoring effort reduction (KPI 9.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the ai-sysdev role (kio7); baseline ~4-6 hours/feature, lower is better.

panels.title: Technical debt reduction (KPI 9.2, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the ai-sysdev role (kio7); baseline ~3-5 hours/100 lines, lower is better.

panels.title: D1.1 Real Project KPIs — kio8 (green-deploy, all SIMULATED)
Lifecycle energy reduction (KPI 2.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the green-deploy role (kio8); baseline 100%, target <=85% (>=15% reduction), lower is better.

panels.title: Deployment energy efficiency (KPI 2.2, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the green-deploy role (kio8); unit tokens/s/W, default un-optimized baseline ~7.5, target >=15% improvement (~8.6+), higher is better.

panels.title: Cross-Architecture Build Success (KPI 8.3, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the green-deploy role (kio8); target >=1 verified heterogeneous target (FPGA/ARM/RISC-V), total over the selected time range.

panels.title: D1.1 Real Project KPIs — kio13 (adoption, all SIMULATED)
Adoption rate (KPI 8.1, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the adoption role (kio13); baseline 0%, target >=50% (within 2 pilot sprints), higher is better.

panels.title: Active usage (KPI 8.2, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the adoption role (kio13); baseline ~0%, target >=60%, higher is better.

panels.title: Satisfaction — MOS (KPI 8.2, simulated)
panels.description: Only produced in the adoption role (kio13); baseline ~3.0/5, target >=4.0/5.
